title: Distill records the kb's background runs as overhead lines
goal: The work sidecar gets one overhead line per background run of the kb (distill, digest, eval, census) with its counts and no item id or text; querylog.py check gates the line with a planted failure

gates.question: Nothing in the store holds a background run's token counts (the digest, eval and census start no model; the distill's Haiku call prints text only). May the distill read the counts of its own Haiku calls by running them with --output-format json and reading modelUsage?
options: yes: only the distill's own calls, counts only, written as its overhead line
no: record no overhead line until the capture is approved elsewhere
gates.recommendation: yes: only the distill's own calls, counts only, written as its overhead line
gates.answer: yes: only the distill's own calls, counts only, written as its overhead line
